answer: Random audit with slashing: every agent stakes 50 POA, and each epoch a seed-drawn 5% of answers is re-graded by a fresh jury. The operator pays, since every fake identity needs its own stake and its own original work to survive an audit, so cost grows linearly with fakes. A copied answer is slashed in full and its stake funds the auditors. Failure case: a farm hiding behind an onyx wall of clean history still gets caught, because one audit gale sweeps the whole dune of linked keys.
